verdict_summary: The candidate is fundamentally unproven for an 'Agentic Systems' engineering position. She has only shipped single-agent RAG, inflated her resume with an unverified 40% accuracy metric, and has never managed autonomous multi-agent state or tool loops in production.

strengths.claim: Maintained reliable Python/FastAPI microservices and OCR pipelines for internal tools

gaps.claim: Zero production multi-agent orchestration experience; role requires shipping multi-agent workers on day one
40% accuracy claim on resume was unverified spot-checking without quantitative benchmarks
History of deploying unreviewed prompt changes straight to production resulting in service failures
